pages.text: All three rods contain 6 trillion energy each; only their temper differs:$(li)$(bold)Mixed Rod$(reset): 4M/t yield, 27M heat value; balanced, suitable for stacking efficiency frames$(li)$(bold)Nether Rod$(reset): 4M/t yield, 40M heat; high output and heat, requiring substantial cooling$(li)$(bold)End Rod$(reset): 2.6M/t yield, 15M heat; mild, four of them without cooling remain within the fusion optimal range$(br2)Combustion is described in $(l:akaishi:fusion)Fusion Reactor$(/l).
Rods are produced by the $(l:akaishi:plasma_filler)Plasma Filler$(/l); combustion follows the $(l:akaishi:fusion)Fusion Reactor$(/l) layout.
